claim: Validated CN/PSOR benchmark generates audited American option risk-surface labels within tested regimes.
allowed_wording: CN/PSOR is the audited benchmark and label generator for tested put and dividend-call regimes.
restricted_wording: Do not call the solver publication-grade across all regimes.
limitations: Smoke-grid errors reflect grid resolution, finite-domain truncation, and nonsmooth payoff time stepping.

claim: Grid, domain, runtime, and shape diagnostics support engineering-scale solver use.
allowed_wording: Engineering-scale stability is supported for the tested base put and dividend-call cases.
restricted_wording: Do not claim analytic-reference or unmasked Gamma convergence.
limitations: Grid-240 is an internal numerical reference, not an analytic benchmark.

claim: Application sweep produced audited American put, dividend-call, and no-dividend control risk surfaces.
allowed_wording: Application surfaces are reported with diagnostics and flagged delicate regimes.
restricted_wording: Do not hide diagnostic failures or use no-dividend controls as dividend-call evidence.
limitations: Thirty-two diagnostic-failure regimes remain audit records and are not clean surrogate labels.

claim: Clean supervised dataset is traceable to diagnostic-passing PSOR regimes with leakage-safe splits.
allowed_wording: Dataset uses regime-level train/validation/test splits and strict Greek masks.
restricted_wording: Do not claim surrogate performance from dataset construction alone.
limitations: Excluded controls and diagnostic-failure regimes are outside the clean-label envelope.

claim: Ordinary direct-price baselines are useful negative evidence and are not obstacle-guaranteed.
allowed_wording: Direct-price baselines expose obstacle and shape limitations.
restricted_wording: Do not call baseline direct-price MLP obstacle-consistent or a Greek engine.
limitations: Baselines are retained for comparison and violation audit, not final claims.

claim: Positive continuation-premium model enforces obstacle consistency for price/premium prediction.
allowed_wording: Positive-premium price surrogate is obstacle-consistent within the clean Stage 6 regime envelope.
restricted_wording: Do not claim this price model estimates boundaries, Greeks, or replaces PSOR.
limitations: Linear sanity baseline has lower aggregate validation RMSE in this run; near-kink error remains larger.

claim: Direct boundary heads provide scoped supervised boundary diagnostics.
allowed_wording: Boundary heads estimate PSOR boundary labels as a separate diagnostic task.
restricted_wording: Do not claim exact free-boundary solving or infer boundaries from the price surrogate.
limitations: Boundary estimates are weaker than price and Delta, especially for call-only generalization.

claim: Price-model derivatives are diagnostic only and do not make the price surrogate a Greek engine.
allowed_wording: Price-model Delta audit motivates using a separate supervised Delta head.
restricted_wording: Do not use price autograd Delta as final Delta evidence.
limitations: Price-model derivative has materially larger RMSE than the bounded supervised Delta head.

claim: Separate bounded supervised Delta head provides scoped strict-mask Delta diagnostics.
allowed_wording: Bounded Delta head is a separate diagnostic head with zero bound violation in evaluated samples.
restricted_wording: Do not claim Gamma support or near-boundary Delta coverage beyond the strict-mask audit.
limitations: Near-boundary strict samples are absent in the capped Stage 10 run.

claim: Integrated modular workflow supports scenario screening with PSOR audit.
allowed_wording: Separate price, boundary, and Delta heads can screen scenarios when audited against PSOR.
restricted_wording: Do not claim the integrated workflow replaces PSOR or includes Gamma.
limitations: Six fresh held-out PSOR cases are evaluated; boundary remains the weakest component.

claim: Stage reports and supplement include evidence-linked visual galleries without expanding scientific claims.
allowed_wording: Visual enrichment improves readability, traceability, and student contribution communication.
restricted_wording: Do not treat richer visuals as evidence that surrogates outperform or replace CN/PSOR.
limitations: Figures communicate existing evidence and do not add solver runs, training, or new validation results.
